name: token-diet
description: Keeps Claude Code sessions cheap: context-size and usage-limit band, handoff nudges, a 95% guard that still allows the handoff write, and Sonnet for general subagents.

contextNudgeTokens.title: Context nudge (tokens)
contextNudgeTokens.description: Nudge to write the handoff and /clear each time context passes another multiple of this.

softLimitPercent.title: Soft limit (%)
softLimitPercent.description: 5-hour/weekly usage at which Claude is told to write the deliverable and handoff now.

hardLimitPercent.title: Hard limit (%)
hardLimitPercent.description: 5-hour/weekly usage at which tool calls are blocked, except reading and writing the handoff file.

handoffFile.title: Handoff file
handoffFile.description: Handoff file path, relative to the project folder.

subagentModel.title: Subagent model
subagentModel.description: Model forced on general-purpose/Explore/Plan subagents (and any asking for opus/fable) unless your last prompt names opus or fable. 'off' disables.
